'''Injectrine''' was a chemical liquid used in the fuel of [[Collor Pondrat/Legends|Collor Pondrat's]] [[Plug-F Mammoth Split-X engine/Legends|Plug-F Mammoth]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]. Once ionized, injectrine was mixed into the [[Plug-F Mammoth Split-X engine/Legends|Split-X turbojet engine's]] [[quold runium]] pressurization system to give the Podracer a boost in speed.
